meta.title: No Asteroids
meta.demoScope: First 15 days of the contract (save carries over on the same PC)
meta.objective: Excavate 5,000,000 m³ asteroid in 90 days (or play No Rush mode)

dataSources.note: Prices and stats are cross-checked against community wikis (wikily.gg, noasteroidss.wiki, noasteroidsguide.wiki), not official Unruled Games data. Patches change numbers.

handheldTools.name: Pickaxe
handheldTools.notes: Your Day 1 tool. Fine for surface veins; replace it as soon as you can.

handheldTools.name: Sledgehammer
handheldTools.notes: Cheapest upgrade and usually the first purchase (Heavy argument).

handheldTools.name: Drill
handheldTools.notes: Opens the deep-stone layer (roughly 55–70% of the radius from the center).

handheldTools.name: Laser
handheldTools.notes: First big price jump. Needed for basalt (roughly 40–55% from the center).

handheldTools.name: Plasma Cutter
handheldTools.notes: Mid-game workhorse before the missile swarm.

handheldTools.name: Missile Swarm
handheldTools.notes: The practical tool for core metal (center to ~40%). In No Rush it can also chip strange matter at half strength.

handheldTools.name: Lance
handheldTools.unlock: Appears after you own an Orbital Strike or Collapsar, or after hitting core metal with a mining tool in the current Year
handheldTools.notes: Bores a tunnel. Since 1.0.6 it no longer pushes you back; it has a charged fire mode.

handheldTools.name: Slicer
handheldTools.notes: Cuts a flat sheet. Since 1.0.6 it cuts three times as often.

shipWeapons.name: Turret
shipWeapons.notes: Cheapest gun. Mounting any gun unlocks Gun on the roof.

shipWeapons.name: Autocannon
shipWeapons.notes: Very high fire rate for the price—strong early value.

shipWeapons.name: Railgun
shipWeapons.notes: Wide radius at a mid-game price.

shipWeapons.name: Mass Driver
shipWeapons.notes: Heavy single shots, smaller radius than the railgun.

shipWeapons.name: Laser Beam
shipWeapons.notes: Highest raw damage per second of any gun.

shipWeapons.name: Orbital Strike
shipWeapons.notes: Largest blast radius. Breaks strange matter and unlocks the Lance and Slicer. Keeps its normal price in The Hard Way.

shipWeapons.name: Collapsar
shipWeapons.notes: Black-hole gun with the highest damage per shot. Breaks strange matter and unlocks the Lance and Slicer.

shipSlots.note: Per-slot mapping inferred from the community total of $869,000 for slots 2–6.

drones.name: Prospector
drones.notes: Mines ore around you, even under rock.

utilities.name: Tractor Beam
utilities.notes: Ship system, needs no slot and can't be sold. Without it, ore knocked loose by ship guns is lost.

utilities.name: Repair Station
utilities.notes: Supply kiosk item from Day 28 (Year 1). Cleans and repairs the ship section by section for permanent bonuses.

utilities.name: Compactor
utilities.notes: Upgrade-station item that raises cargo capacity for specific ores each level; the tooltip shows the next level's bonus.

utilities.name: Jetpack
utilities.notes: Buying it unlocks Rocketeer. Flights were lengthened in the Nov 25 update.

ores.name: Neutronium
ores.notes: Sits around the strange-matter heart at the center in new campaigns.

ores.name: Antimatter
ores.notes: Explodes when smashed (Boom achievement). Price was raised from about $56 on Nov 20.

ores.name: Strange Matter
ores.breaks: Lance, Slicer, Orbital Strike or Collapsar only
ores.notes: New asteroid heart added Nov 25, 2026—only in new campaigns and new Years.

rockStockNote: From Day 35 of Year 1 (and every shift from Year 2), broken rock sells as "Rock" at a flat $2, ignoring glut.

minimum.cpu: 4 cores — Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
minimum.gpu: DirectX 11 GPU with 2 GB VRAM (GTX 1050 / RX 560 / Intel Iris Xe)

recommended.cpu: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
recommended.gpu: GeForce GTX 1660 or Radeon RX 5600 XT (4 GB VRAM)

recommended.cpu: Apple M1 Pro, M2, or newer
